instruction: Return one structured replacement edit for the exact placeholder // LIGHTYEAR_BUILDER_JOURNEY\n in LightyearOperationsTest.java. Use only public_contract, public_api, deterministic_support, check_structure and compile. Read the journey contract and deterministic support. Compile the candidate before proposing it. The compiler has a frozen budget; compilation success is not business success. Use JourneySupport directly without defining or copying that class. The controller appends its pinned source deterministically. Generate a new journey Java JUnit test in org.idempiere.test extending AbstractTestCase, using the pinned real model/workflow APIs. Do not hard-code predicted business results or substitute SQL writes for application workflows. Read observed totals and flags from saved objects. Independent private gates judge the committed native database. You cannot change those gates. After any failure, only the attached closed diagnostic objects may inform a repair. Preserve the initial scenario and trace contract. The edit always replaces the placeholder with the complete candidate, including on repair.

repair_format.candidate: Complete replacement; never an incremental patch.
repair_format.diagnostics: Only the delivered closed objects; no raw failure text, hidden expected values or private references.

support_assembly: Remove the support package and public class modifier; trim only boundary whitespace and append with two newline separators. No candidate logic transformation.

trace_format.identical_field_set: Both lanes must emit the same field names. Do not emit extra lane-specific fields.
trace_format.instructions: Emit actual observed native/model values. Format intermediate decimal trace values with stripTrailingZeros().toPlainString() on both lanes; never exponent notation. Emit the journey section's declared trace fields and no exception text as a successful trace field.
trace_format.output: Write Properties XML to System.getProperty("lightyear.output"), including in finally. Final status completed-and-committed only after committing. database is oracle or postgresql.
